description: The plot illustrates the comparison of BLEU scores between context consistency and context inconsistency under the prefix-constrained decoding setting as the length of the gold prefix varies. The x-axis, labeled "the length of gold prefix," has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," also has a linear scale, spanning from 23 to 29 with a tick label interval of 1. Two lines are plotted: the blue dashed line with circle markers represents "Consistency: wait-1," starting at a BLEU score of approximately 25 at a prefix length of 0, decreasing to around 23.5 at a prefix length of 3, and then increasing to about 28.2 at a prefix length of 20; and the orange solid line with square markers represents "Inconsistency: wait-9," beginning at a BLEU score of roughly 25.2 at a prefix length of 0, fluctuating between 25 and 26.2 across the x-axis range, ending at a BLEU score of approximately 25.8 at a prefix length of 20.
